author: reek
body: Stage 4b/5 of the proof system: the `for all (x : T), P` claim form and the `induction on x` proof body are parsed, and the obligation is CHECKED by structural subgoal generation (delta/iota over each constructor, with an inductive hypothesis at every recursive field) and erased at emit (CDX4020). For `add n Zero === n`: the Zero case reduces to `Zero === Zero` (Refl); the Succ case reduces to `Succ (add k Zero) === Succ k`, discharged by `cong ih` where the inductive hypothesis ih is `add k Zero === k`. This is a real proof, not an unproven axiom.
